description: Versification tables behind @lectio/refs (L-006): chapter and verse counts and cross-versification mappings. Numbers only; no Bible text.

sources.name: SIL libpalaso versification files (Paratext standard versifications)

files.notes: BHS for the Old Testament, UBS GNT / Nestle-Aland for the New; Greek-only material in separate books (S3Y, SUS, BEL, LJE, ESG).
Stuttgart Vulgate (VUL83) and Nova Vulgata (NVL98). Upstream gives no mapping for Tobit, Judith, Sirach or Esther.
Rahlfs Septuagint: Greek Daniel (DAG), Greek Esther (ESG), Ezra-Nehemiah as one book (EZR 1-23).
English Bibles (KJV/RSV tradition): psalm titles not counted as verses, Joel 2:28-32, Malachi 4.

sources.name: Lectio supplements to the libpalaso mappings

files.notes: Jonah follows vul.vrs's own chapter table (Hebrew division, 1:16 2:11) instead of its mapping lines, which assume the English division.
Maps the Greek additions in DAG 3:24-90 onto S3Y, as vul.vrs does for DAN.
Maps Catholic English Daniel (eng.vrs DAG, 14 chapters) onto org.vrs, combining eng.vrs's DAN shifts with vul.vrs's mapping of the additions.
